recipe.title: Kūmara-topped creamy chicken and vege pie
recipe.notes: This is from Nadia Lim's cookbook, "Yum!"
recipe.prep: Bring a medium pot of water to the boil. Preheat oven on a low grill setting.

i.n: cauliflower, stalk and florets roughly chopped
leek, white and pale green part, diced
cornflour, mixed with 1 Tbs cold water

method.s: Boil kūmara and cauliflower for about 15 minutes or until soft. Drain well and leave on stovetop (with element off) to steam and dry off. Mash with a masher. Reserve.
Meanwhile, start the filling. Pat chicken dry, season with salt and pepper, and fry in a drizzle of oil over high heat for three minutes each side until light golden but not cooked through.

Reserve chicken. Reduce pan to medium-high heat and add another drizzle of oil. Cook leek, celery, garlic, thyme and water for 4-5 minutes or until softened, scraping bottom of pan with a wooden spoon to release any pan brownings.
Roughly chop chicken 1-2 cm and return to pan with any resting juices. Add stock and soy sauce.
Bring to a simmer and cook through for about three minutes, until chicken is cooked through.
Reduce heat to low. Stir through sour cream, cornflour mixture and mustard. Cook for 1-2 minutes until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and season to taste.
Transfer the chicken mixture to a baking dish. Top with kūmara mixture, then sprinkle over cheese.
Grill for 4-5 minutes until cheese is golden. Leave to rest in dish for 5-10 minutes before serving.
